name: EnhancedInput Tools
description: RQL module for Unreal's Enhanced Input system: author full control schemes (on foot, vehicle, menu): input actions, mapping contexts with priorities, keyboard / mouse / gamepad mappings, triggers (hold, tap, pulse, chords, combos, toggles) and modifiers (dead zones, negate, swizzle, scale), player-rebindable keys with Enhanced Input user settings, and the Blueprint wiring that swaps contexts on possession and binds actions to functions; query everything back.
_comment: Install-catalog metadata (one unreal-mcp-cli ExtensionDescriptor). 'version' is the .uplugin VersionName; change both with `python scripts/extension_release.py bump --plugin <Plugin> --version <x.y.z>`. 'tools' is empty: the extension adds an RQL module (docs/rql.md), not MCP tools. 'minCoreVersion' is the lowest supported Unreal-MCP core; 'enginePlugins' are the engine plugins the installer enables.
